Basic Trainer: Hey! You're on my route — you battle me to pass.
My team and I have been waiting all morning. Let's go!
Don't skip me. I've got a strategy this time.
Trainer eyes meet trainer eyes — that's the rule.
…You want a fight? You've got one.
First trainer of the day. Lucky me.
Gym Trainer: You don't reach the Leader by walking past me.
Hmph! Prove yourself in the front rooms first.
This gym's counting on me to thin out the crowd.
I train here every day. I've seen every gimmick.
Pass me first. Then we'll see if the Leader bothers.
Gym Leader: Enough talk. Show me the badge fight.
This badge isn't for tourists. It's for trainers.
Show me what you've trained for.
You've come far. Don't stop here.
My Pokémon and I won't hold back. Match it.
Elite Trainer: I've been waiting for a real fight all week.
Technique beats raw power — usually. Let's test the rule.
…Impressive. But I'm the gatekeeper for a reason.
Think you can keep up with the late-route circuit?
This won't be a warm-up. Bring your six.
Rival: There you are. I was starting to think you took the long way to dodge me.
I didn't stop training when you walked off. Hope you didn't either.
You don't get to walk past this one. Not today.
New team since last time. Read it fast or lose slow.
We settle it on the field, same as always. Not on the road.
Don't hold back. I'd notice — and I never do.
I built this roster to counter yours.
I scouted your last three fights. Still feeling confident?
Adapt or lose. That's been the rule between us since Pallet.
Different partners this round. Bet you can't guess the lead.
E1: Most challengers who reach this room are already finished. They just haven't been told.
…You climbed Victory Road. Good. The road was the easy part.
Four rooms stand between you and the chair. I'm the one you'll think you understand.
No rookie excuses past this door. Sit your six down across from mine.
E2: You cleared the first room. People always do. It's this one they remember.
…The trainer before me was kind. That was their mistake, not mine.
The hall narrows from here. So does the light. Sit your six down.
You're not tired yet. You will be. Begin.
E3: This deep in, challengers start fighting the room instead of me. Don't.
…You can feel the chair from here, can't you. So can I. It isn't yours yet.
Two rooms behind you. I break your rhythm, not your record. Let's see which.
Whatever you saved for the Champion — spend some here, or you won't reach them.
E4: The Champion's door is at my back. Nobody has walked through it past me in a long time.
…This is the room most people lose in. They never see it coming. It's quiet, like this.
One fight left after me. Make sure there's enough of your team left to win it.
No regrets. No excuses. Last door. Begin.
Champion: …So you've come. The chamber's been quiet.
I'm the Champion. Show me why I shouldn't stay one.
This is where the road ends — for one of us.
I won't hold back. I've earned the right not to.
Show me the trainer the road made.
Victory Road: Fog, boulders, and people who won't move. Pick a fight or back down.
Only the strong make the climb. Prove it.
The air up here's thin. So's patience.
One misstep on this rock and the climb is over.
Turn back, or earn the next handhold.
